Class Phase

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.gc06.mesos.model.gameTurnManager.Phase
Direct Known Subclasses:
EndOfRoundPhase, EventResolutionPhase, OfferResolutionPhase, PlacingTotemPhase
public abstract class Phase extends Object
The abstract base class representing a generic phase in the game's state machine. Defines the contract for all possible player actions, throwing exceptions by default to enforce that only concrete phases handle their specific allowed actions.

  • Method Details

    • placeTotem

      public void placeTotem(TurnManager turnManager, Player player, TileSlot tileSlot, Board board) throws IllegalPhaseActionException
      This method attempts to place a player's totem on a specified tile slot. By default, this action is not permitted and must be overridden by specific phases.
      Parameters:
      turnManager - The turn manager orchestrating the game flow.
      player - The player attempting to place the totem.
      tileSlot - The target tile slot for the totem.
      board - The game board.
      Throws:
      IllegalPhaseActionException - If the totem cannot be placed during the current phase.

    • startPlayerOfferResolution

      public void startPlayerOfferResolution(TurnManager turnManager, Player player, TileSlot tileSlot) throws IllegalPhaseActionException
      This method starts the resolution of the offer track for a specific player. By default, this action is not permitted and must be overridden by specific phases.
      Parameters:
      turnManager - The turn manager orchestrating the game flow.
      player - The player resolving their offer.
      tileSlot - The tile slot chosen by the player.
      Throws:
      IllegalPhaseActionException - If offer resolution cannot be started during the current phase.

    • pickCardFromBottom

      public void pickCardFromBottom(TurnManager turnManager, Player player, EventCard card, Board board) throws IllegalPhaseActionException, IllegalArgumentException
      This method attempts to pick an EventCard from the bottom row of the board. Players generally cannot pick event cards; they are resolved automatically. By default, this action throws an exception.
      Parameters:
      turnManager - The turn manager orchestrating the game flow.
      player - The player attempting to pick the card.
      card - The EventCard in question.
      board - The game board.
      Throws:
      IllegalPhaseActionException - Always, as players cannot pick event cards directly.
      IllegalArgumentException - If the provided arguments are invalid.
